def test_filter_by_prefix():
    # basic filtering
    assert filter_by_prefix(["apple", "apricot", "banana"], "ap") == ["apple", "apricot"]

    # no matches
    assert filter_by_prefix(["apple", "banana"], "z") == []

    # empty input list
    assert filter_by_prefix([], "a") == []

    # empty prefix matches all
    assert filter_by_prefix(["abc", "def"], "") == ["abc", "def"]

    # case-sensitive
    assert filter_by_prefix(["Apple", "apple"], "ap") == ["apple"]

    # prefix longer than strings
    assert filter_by_prefix(["a", "ab"], "abc") == []
